title: Destination registers for copy operations
statement: For each copy-operation site, assign its destination among the 18 registers as follows: multiplication into the counter, setup of the shift value, push, and both pop-count operations target the counter register; multiplication into the accumulator and popping the stack into the accumulator target the accumulator register; setup of the radius targets the radius register; the root operation targets the level register; and moving the halved stack into the quotient register targets the quotient register.
hypotheses_covered: The input is a copy-operation site
